# Pillar EXR08: Long-term reversal
Definition: USD total return of the sleeve's reference index (spliced under ELG07, ^NDX before QQQ) from month -60 to month -13, minus the world reference's over the same window. Price-based, so it is rebuilt exactly in REC04. Weight 0.6 of EXR (12% of X). EXR06 + EXR08 + FAC01 are capped at 25% of X.
Source: yfinance .L and proxy adjusted closes; ^NDX (verified from 1985-10); Ken French market returns for spliced history (verified). Better when: lower. Informs: portfolio_mix.
Week 2026-W46.
